pages.title: What connects your day?
pages.subtext: Pick a story. Think about all the different ways things can reach each other.

pages.title: Which way would you go?
pages.subtext: Explore a few routes through town. There are no wrong answers here.

pages.title: One idea. Lots of possibilities.
pages.subtext: The same kind of thinking helps solve many different problems.

contexts.title: Finding your way
contexts.description: You are heading across town. Some roads are busy, others are quiet. How many ways could you go?
contexts.question: What would make you choose a different route?

contexts.title: Where is your parcel?
contexts.description: A package stops at sorting centres on its way to you. Different journeys can take different amounts of time.
contexts.question: Could another route get it there sooner?

contexts.title: Sending a message
contexts.description: When you send a message, it can travel through several devices before arriving. The journey is almost invisible.
contexts.question: What happens if one connection stops working?
